name: Harness Skill Proposal
description: Propose new or revised harness skills and policy text from recurring failure patterns while keeping scope limited to harness assets.

operational.approval_boundary: Safe for proposal drafting inside harness-owned assets; require human approval before any change outside harness scope.
operational.use_when: Use when repeated harness failures justify drafting new or revised harness skills and policy text.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
